messages.subject: Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Reaction Search International Houston Team,

Your executive-search coverage across energy and utilities aligns with my international leadership background in mining, energy transition, ESG and institutional affairs. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where major projects require regulatory coordination, institutional trust and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
